graph.title: Controlling the AD5206 Digital Potentiometer with SPI
notes: AD5206 is not in the catalogue; added as ad5206 with ports named by pin function (A1-A6, W1-W6, B1-B6, GND, CS, VDD, SDI, CLK, VSS). Each channel's A-W-B is modelled as 'through' pairs.

The Fritzing image was not available; breadboard hole placement is an assumption. The DIP-24 chip straddles the centre gap: pins 1-12 in top-bank row e (columns 4-15), pins 13-24 in bottom-bank row f (columns 15-4).
Wiring follows the code comments: all A pins to +5V, all B pins to GND, VDD to 5V, VSS and GND to ground, CS to D10, SDI to D11 (MOSI), CLK to D13 (SCK).
Each wiper (W1-W6) goes by jumper wire to an LED anode; each LED cathode goes through a 220 ohm resistor to the ground rail (tn). Rail 'tp' is 5V, rail 'tn' is GND, fed from the Uno 5V and GND.1.
Channel numbers in code (0-5) map to the datasheet wiper addresses; the tutorial wires W1-W6 each to its own LED.
Uno 5V, GND.1 and the SPI pins are connected by jumper wires into header sockets.
